storyInfo: Witness No. 2 Ukusik recounted her story at the hearing: A man named Antosha took her in. He led a radical group calling itself the Unbound, opposing Pavlovich’s brutal rule in Katorga.

attributes.content: Order! Order!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Answer the question, Young Zoya!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I already have, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I can't describe what I didn't see. I do not know if Sonya had anything to do with the assassination attempt on the Emperor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: The committee has heard that you are regularly seen together.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: No, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I have already stated that I did not support them so strongly, and I am no member of the Ursus Student Self-Government Group. As you can see—
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I know. They did not even give you a badge.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: And, may I ask if the cross-examination proceedings have already begun?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: According to the bylaws of the 87th Provisional Inquiry Hearing Committee, cross-examination proceedings can only begin once the relevance of all witnesses and evidence has been properly established.
attributes.name: Council Parliamentarian

attributes.content: Prior to this, the witness may decline to answer questions.
attributes.name: Council Parliamentarian

attributes.content: I have no further questions.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Arbiter...?
attributes.name: Council Parliamentarian

attributes.content: ...Young Zoya, I have read your file, and certain things are very plain. For example—
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: You could choose to be a good girl.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Summon the next witness!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Summoning Witness No. 2. Witness No. 1, return to your seat.
attributes.name: Council Parliamentarian

attributes.content: Thank you.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: You...? Why are you here?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Hmph.
attributes.name: Aloof Girl

attributes.content: What is your name, Witness No. 2?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Ukusik.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: A strange name.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: (Whisper) Here are the reference files, Councilor Artyom.
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: (Whisper) Orphaned vagrant who grew up on the streets, owing her survival to the protection of the older homeless. They say her de facto guardian died at the hands of the Ursus Student Self-Government Group.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: (Whisper) She is no friend to the students... I instructed her on what she should and should not say.
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: Very well. You may speak, Ukusik. No need to be frightened.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: There's nothing to be frightened of... ahem. 'Honored members of the hearing committee.' Did I get that right?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: This is what happened—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I was selling newspapers on the street corner that night, waiting for Antosha to send someone to take over for me.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Antosha's my boss. I'll talk about him again later—anyway, I saw a bunch of people running to the ballroom, and I was thinking, did something happen to Antosha?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Then a bunch of cops showed up and blocked all the streets. That was when I realized I should have gotten out of there at the first sign of trouble.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I saw one of my pals just standing there blankly while the crowd pushed him around. He yelled something when he saw me—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: But I couldn't hear what he said before the cop's bashed his head in with a nightstick, and then he disappeared...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Wait, wait!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Skip the extraneous details, child... no one knows what you're talking about.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: What am I supposed to say, then? I don't even know how to read, did you think I would talk like a salesman?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: How about you just tell me what to say, and I'll say it?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: No!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The arbiter glares at the noble next to him, who avoids his stare while wiping the sweat from his own forehead.
Let's start from the beginning. What kind of organization do you belong to? Who's this boss you were talking about?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Why were you there that night? Tell us everything that you know. Conceal nothing.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Everything?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Yes, everything.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: That's gonna take a while. Can I sit down?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: No!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.text: Start at the beginning, the beginning... where's the beginning?
From when I was born? Nothing to talk about there. My mom gave birth to me, then she died because she couldn't afford medicine.
The dad who abandoned me? There's even less to talk about. I barely remember him.
Getting drafted into the pipe cleaners, watching other three or four year-old kids like me die in the energy pipelines...
Oh, I can't talk about that? I thought it was legal.
Fine, fine, I guess I'll start with the day I met Antosha...

attributes.content: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, can I go home now? You've kept me locked up for so long, my parents are gonna be worried. They can tell you that I've always been a good girl!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: But today is Monday.
attributes.name: Lazy Police

attributes.content: What's Monday got to do with it?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Good kids are in school on Mondays, not stealing on the streets.
attributes.name: Lazy Police

attributes.content: Let me see... three hours until school's done. Your parents won't be worried. No rush.
attributes.name: Lazy Police

attributes.content: Let me out, you svoloch!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Hah, look at 'em.
Who are you laughing at?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Me? I'm not laughing...
attributes.name: Jailed Worker

attributes.content: Get lost, I'm not talking about you! You over there, kid, what are you laughing at?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I'm laughing at him. Look—
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: I followed the student's gaze and saw the lazy cop looking down at a pie, like he wasn't sure what to do.
It was almost teatime. If he filled his belly now, he wouldn't be able to enjoy the cookies fresh out of the oven at the crossroads.
But the pie filled with fruit and cream looked really good. My mouth was watering just seeing it. I didn't understand—
What's so funny about that?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Come closer and I'll tell you—
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: He won't get to enjoy his pie at all, if he hesitates any longer.
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: What do you mean?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Wanna bet? You're shaking your head? Don't have the guts? Hah, just you wait...
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: I didn't believe him at all. I don't make bets unless I've got a sure thing.
I saw the cop look check the time—the head cop would be back soon, and then he wouldn't get to enjoy his pie at all.
So he opened his mouth...
Antosha! I'm here!
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: Antosha nodded at the student, then took out the cop clean and easy. He found the keys on the cop and gave it to the student.
Hurry. They'll be here soon to check the noise.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: How was I to know that you would use a micro-Originium bomb? Aren't those supposed to be really expensive? How did you get Matvey to agree?
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: I don't need him to agree to do anything... besides, nothing is more worth more than human life.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I thought nothing was more valuable than liberty.
attributes.name: Jailed Student

attributes.content: The student's chains dropped to the ground, and he walked out of his cell before punching Antosha in the shoulder. I learned later that's how they show trust and say thank you to each other.
Hey—wait for me! Take me with you!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Do you know this kid?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: The student shook his head. I knew I had to seize the chance, or else those cops would take it out on the rest of us when they came back.
Those men... they're mean to me! I don't have anywhere else to go!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Not buying that one, huh? Well, you can't just leave me here to die!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I can do lots of things. I can help—I can tell you're not honest folk, and neither am I!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I heard the sound of a police whistle. It wasn't far. There was no change in Antosha's expression. Normally, that means my words didn't work.
You're right... we're not 'honest folk'.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Where's home? Maybe I can take you back—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Home? You mean the sewers of Odoyev? I don't need you to take me there.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Here, the keys. Catch—you know how to open a lock, don't you?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: 'Course I do.

attributes.text: Before running from the police station after Antosha, I picked up the pie from the ground. It was mostly clean.
I stuffed it in my mouth as I ran for my life. It was good, really sweet. The cop should've eaten it sooner.
We were going to Katorga.

attributes.content: We can't afford another failure. There are a hundred invalids here, plus the families taking care of them.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Pavlovich's forces keep growing by the day, and their equipment's getting better too. We blast open a way out, they block it again. And our explosives... we've got maybe two shots left.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Only by taking out Pavlovich as soon as possible do we stand a chance of turning this around.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Uh-huh.
attributes.name: Rescued Student

attributes.content: Did you get a good look at him, Yura? How much security does Pavlovich have?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Two bodyguards in close company at all times. Anything else is unclear.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: We've been planning based on your idea, and—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I'm done. Gone any more?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Give her the bread basket—look here, remember this face, and find him in Tsarevgrad Raion tomorrow, he'll help you—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You got water? I can't get this down...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Bottle's in the pantry, get it yourself—look at me, not her! The ball's a few weeks away. Do your job and don't get caught. You understand me?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I'll be fine. It's not the first time I've worked as a waiter at a ball.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: This is the Winter Ball. You might be the nimblest amongst us, but you need to cut that absent-mindedness out if you want to get things done.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Who are you calling absent-minded? Besides, we pick the pockets of the rich and sell unattended bicycles every day.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: Do you write your three or four daily love letters to the same person?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Come on, Antosha, you're no fun. The redistribution of wealth is serious work, but that doesn't mean everyone has to go around as stone-faced as you all the time.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: I'm just reminding you that what we're doing is considered a crime by the ruling class, and we're doing it for—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: For vengeance.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: Yes, vengeance. But far more than that.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: The professor was willing to die for us because he believed we can liberate Ursus and usher in a future of freedom... true freedom.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Creak—
I was standing by the wall and gulping from the bottle when the door suddenly opened.
It was a young man, much taller than I am. He looked really tired, but his back was perfectly straight, like it got a bar of steel in it.
He cocked his head questioningly when he saw me drinking from the bottle, but said nothing.

attributes.name: Yura
attributes.content: You're back, Matvey. We left some bread for you—

attributes.name: Yura
attributes.content: Hey, there's only half a piece left! Who ate the rest?
I said nothing and quietly put the bottle back.
Ahem. I brought the kid back from the police station. I thought...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: What were you talking about?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Something failed because you underestimated the nobles, but you've learned your lesson for next time. Did I get all that right?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: ...You were talking about killing in front of a little girl?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Killing? Oh, so that's what you were talking about.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: We unanimously agreed that we must assassinate the nobles on the list.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: A list that keeps getting longer. I'm not sure which version you're talking about.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: ...I'll stop when Ursus is cleansed of all scum.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Matvey stared silently at Antosha for a long time, then tossed him the bottle that I put back.
Ahem. I don't really mind if you talk about it. People are either alive or dead. Why avoid talking about that?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Oh, for heaven's sake, just shut up!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We don't have any spare beds.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Didn't you think about where she was going to sleep before you brought her back?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: I can sleep on the floor.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You heard her. She can sleep on the floor.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Alright, I'll think of something! I should have thought about it before I brought her back!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You can sleep in his bed until he figures out something. He can make do with a corner of the workshop.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Fine, whatever you say. Couldn't have built this house without you anyway.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: We can get you something to eat, girl, then we'll take you home once you've rested.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Home? Where?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Matvey, she's—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I'm sorry...
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Still, you shouldn't be with us.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: Why? Because you're all nobles who get to go to school? I never went to school, but there's lots that I can do!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: We're not the kind of students you're thinking of...
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: (Whisper) Antosha, you know these are dangerous times. We shouldn't—
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: I know! You pick pockets too, don't you? I can help, I'm good at it! Well, I did screw up that last time, but still...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Please, I can help, all I ask is a bit of bread, I don't eat much anyway...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I have nowhere else to go.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: ...You heard her, Matvey. She's another one without a home.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: With her size, she is less likely to be noticed. We could use a backup plan for communicating with the topside.
attributes.name: Yura

attributes.content: Alright, listen up. We're sharing our bread with you, but this is not charity, just extending a hand to someone in need—you don't need to live off anyone's charity.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Everyone has a right to live with their heads held high. If someone is unable to live decently through honest labor, the fault does not lie with that person.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Now, let me ask you something.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Do you believe that there will come a day when we bring down the privileged class, when all of us share equal rights in everything?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Honestly, I didn't really understand what he was saying, but he was pretty excited and all I could do was nod.
You mean... we'll all get to eat bread? Even cake?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: If I get to eat every day, that's great.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Good.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Welcome to the Unbound—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: It looked like he just remembered he never asked me my name.
What's your name?
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: I don't have a name. 'Kid' isn't a name, right? Or 'Girl'? Well, I'll know you're talking to me, if you call me that.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: You talk like you're always trying to bite.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Ukusik—'little thing that bites'. That's your name!
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: What? I don't—
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Come, Ukusik, let's get you a clean pillow.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: I said I don't wanna be called that!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: I will—never—answer to that!
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.text: Of course, I ended up answering to it. What a strange name.
Maybe it meant they accepted me as one of them.
For the first time, I found a place that wouldn't kick me out.

attributes.content: <p=1>One month later</><p=2>5:30 P.M. 1 hour before the Winter Ball</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Is Yura ready?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Yes. I gave him the knife and poison. When the ball begins, he will approach the target with a tray of champagne.
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: Killing is easy. The hard part is getting away afterwards... knife or poison. Which will he choose?
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: The one that draws more attention.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: That's what I would do.
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: The professor said that simply carrying out justice is not enough...
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: It must be seen by all.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: This is a dangerous mission, but also our best opportunity, given that guests are not permitted to bring their own security into the Winter Ball. Yura... never mind. I trust him.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Have more faith, Antosha. We didn't follow you to watch you hang your head.
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: You don't follow me. We all chose to be here of our own accord.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I know. You're not our leader, of course.
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: But ideals must have direction. It was your idea to come to Katorga to continue the struggle.
attributes.name: Resolute Girl

attributes.content: When Pavlovich is dead, we can leave this place together, and our long struggle will be over.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Antosha.
attributes.name: Matvey

attributes.content: I saw several people walk in. They were the same age as the students, but wearing worker clothes. They were Antosha's friends, gathered here to do something important.
Important things come together to make great things. That's what Antosha told me.
I saw the crowd gather around Antosha, waiting for him to speak. Antosha took a deep breath. The light shined through the window and fell on his chest.
I see you. My fellow students, my brothers, my comrades.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.text: I see you as I did the first time we met.
\n\nWe were gathered around a great man, listening to his teachings.
I see you thinking of the same questions that you did at the time—
<color=#d70000>How did Ursus come to this?</color>
<color=#d70000>Where will Ursus go?</color>
<color=#d70000>What can we do?</color>
I can see it in your eyes that you have lost all hope for this country, and I am the same!
We tried. We are not like those incompetent successors who only dream and talk! We tried!
Peaceful means did not work. We paid the price.
Words were too weak to move an empire steeped in rot and decay.
The professor lost his life because of the 'peace' that we chose, giving his life in exchange for ours.
I see you as I saw our comrades through prison bars, as I fought back tears, witnessing his blood on the execution ground—
Blood that flowed for us!
Blood that has long run dry. None of us fear punishment or death.

attributes.content: We want...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Liberty.
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: We need...
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: To destroy.
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: We betray the laws that bind us, for they betrayed the people!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Destroy all the rotten and pointless systems and institutions, for they are beyond repair!
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Burn them and hang them, and tear it all down for bread and liberty! Only on the ruins of everything that came before can Ursus finally find—
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Rebirth!
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: We are the Unbound. We shall be bound no more.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Their voices were stacked one on top of the other, making me dizzy. I stood next to Matvey, the only one who remained quiet throughout.
I didn't really understand the meaning of those words, but I noticed that Antosha looked this way every so often.
He wasn't look at me, of course... it looked like he was after Matvey's approval.
I don't know what kind of agreement they had, but I knew Matvey would tell Antosha if he went wrong.
And then...
We saw the one we were meeting with—Yura. He was standing in the crowd, looking confused and lost...
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: He didn't manage to kill his target. The plan got interrupted.
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.content: Maybe he was thinking, why were there so many students and police outside the ballroom?
attributes.name: Ukusik

attributes.text: 'What were they fighting for?'
